name: Coco-caprylate
description: Coco-caprylate (CAS 95912-86-0 ) is a lightweight ester derived from coconut fatty alcohols and caprylic acid, used as an emollient, carrier, and skin-feel modifier in cosmetic formulations. It delivers a dry, non-greasy skin feel that synthetic silicones traditionally provided, making it a preferred choice in clean-label and silicone-free product development for modern brands. In skincare and color cosmetics, this ingredient functions as a spreading agent and emollient base in serums, foundations, and sunscreens, improving texture without any unwanted heaviness. It acts as a solvent and carrier for UV filters, pigments, and active ingredients, enabling uniform dispersion across formulations. In hair care, it is used in leave-on treatments and sprays. This ester provides lightweight lubrication without residue buildup. Industrial and cosmetic-grade lubricant formulations also use it where a bio-based, low-viscosity ester is needed for surface slip. The product is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care manufacturers and formulators. Standard packaging includes drums and IBCs, with bulk quantities available for commercial procurement.
